tools.name: list_howto_pages
tools.description: List every published how-to page on stepcode.dev — 36 analysis x tool cells (Excel, Google Sheets, R, Python, SQL, DAX/Power BI) with slug, title, analysis family, tool, vertical and whether the tool's approach diverges from the others.

tools.name: search_howto_pages
tools.description: Filter the how-to index by analysis family, tool, vertical, and/or a case-insensitive text query against title + analysis name. All filters are optional and combine with AND; call with no arguments to get every page (same as list_howto_pages).

tools.name: get_howto_page
tools.description: Get the full howto/v2 contract for one page by slug (from list_howto_pages /  search_howto_pages): intro, per-step teach/intent/code, divergence notes, cross-tool links, and grounding.

tools.name: list_analysis_families
tools.description: List the analysis families on stepcode.dev (e.g. flight-risk, diversity-index-EBIT-impact) with the tools each is shown in and how many pages exist for it.
